translations.web: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.
translations.bsb: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.
translations.kjv: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
translations.asv: The king's daughter within the palace is all glorious: Her clothing is inwrought with gold.
